Interpretation: Jack decides to visit a museum that is 150 miles away from home. He drives his car at 75 miles per hour round trip (i.e., both ways). He spends 6 hours at the museum. Distance one-way = 150 miles. Round trip distance = 300 miles. Speed = 75 mph. Travel time = distance / speed = 300 / 75 = 4 hours. Then add 6 hours at museum = total 10 hours.

Thus answer: 10 hours.
